name: Da Lat Xanh International Run 2026 (Cool Race 1.5°C Dalat)
short_description: The Da Lat Xanh International Run 2026 (Cool Race 1.5°C Dalat) is on Sunday 22 November 2026 in central Da Lat, Lam Dong, over 1.5 km, 5 km, 10 km and 21 km.
ai_summary: Giai chay Quoc te vi Da Lat Xanh 2026, also called Cool Race 1.5°C - Dalat 2026, is on Sunday 22 November 2026, with DA HAE International Co., Ltd listed as organiser. The current plan places the race hub at Lam Vien Square beside Xuan Huong Lake, with routes through central Da Lat. The event is framed around the environment and Vietnam-Korea exchange, over 1.5 km, 5 km, 10 km and 21 km.

core_facts.organizer: Belove Mountain and DA HAE International Co., Ltd
core_facts.venue: Lam Vien Square, beside Xuan Huong Lake, Da Lat

faqs.question: How much are entries for the Da Lat Xanh International Run 2026?
faqs.answer: Super-early-bird prices (21 September to 15 October) run from 200,000 VND for 1.5 km to 450,000 VND for 21 km. Early-bird and regular tiers follow, with the 21 km reaching 720,000 VND from 31 October to 12 November. Combo tickets for two to four runners are also offered.

faqs.question: What are the age limits at the Da Lat Xanh International Run 2026?
faqs.answer: The 1.5 km is for participants aged six and over, born in 2020 or earlier. The 5 km starts at age eight, and the 10 km and 21 km are for runners aged 14 and over, born in 2014 or earlier. Personal-detail changes close at 11.59pm on 31 October 2026.
